segments.sn45.6:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn45.6:1.4: Katamaṃ nu kho, bhante, brahmacariyaṃ, katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānan”ti?
segments.sn45.6:2.1: “Ayameva kho, bhikkhu, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṃ, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn45.6:2.3: Yo kho, bhikkhu, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo – idaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānan”ti.
